THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA
SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated, ShiGaiizdctober, 2026
No. HCM. I1/20/2020/Comp/Pt-1/3412 : in supersession of this Registry's Notification
No HCM.ll/I05/202/Estt/2965 dated 6th October, 2021, Hon'ble the Chief Justice, High
Court of Meghalaya is pleased to designate the Court of Shri Flavian R Marak, Judicial
Magistrate First Class as Virtual Court for traffic eChallan cases in the State of
Meghalaya with immediate effect until further order(s). /
REGISTRAR GENERAL
Memo No. HCM. I1/20/2020/Comp/Pt-1/3412-A Dated, Shillong the l+-October, 2026
